aboutBio: I'm a passionate Full-Stack Developer and SAP ABAP Developer who enjoys building modern, scalable, and user-focused applications. I love turning ideas into meaningful digital experiences through clean code and thoughtful design.

My experience includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and SAP ABAP. I enjoy bridging modern web technologies with enterprise solutions while continuously learning and exploring new technologies.
Beyond web development, I'm passionate about AI, automation, Raspberry Pi, and building innovative software that solves real-world problems with performance, simplicity, and great user experience.
